title: test_resume_crud_operations
description: Verify that authenticated users can create, retrieve, update, and delete resumes via the /api/resumes and /api/resumes/[id] endpoints, ensuring data integrity and proper authorization.

title: test_ats_analysis_with_ai
description: Test the /api/resumes/[id]/analyze endpoint to ensure it returns accurate ATS scores, improvement suggestions, and handles optional target job input correctly for authenticated users.

title: test_resume_adaptation_for_job
description: Validate the /api/resumes/[id]/adapt endpoint to confirm it tailors resumes to specific job descriptions using AI, returns adapted content and change logs, and requires authentication.

title: test_resume_import_functionality
description: Check the /api/resumes/import endpoint to ensure users can upload PDF or DOCX files, that the content is correctly extracted into editable resumes, and that the process handles errors gracefully.

title: test_linkedin_audit_creation_and_listing
description: Verify the /api/linkedin/audit endpoint supports creating new LinkedIn profile audits and listing existing audits for authenticated users, returning scores and actionable suggestions.

title: test_linkedin_audit_retrieval_and_deletion
description: Test the /api/linkedin/audit/[id] endpoint to ensure authenticated users can retrieve specific LinkedIn audit results and delete audits as needed, with proper authorization checks.

title: test_job_search_functionality
description: Validate the /api/jobs endpoint to confirm it returns relevant job listings based on role keywords and location parameters, handles empty or invalid queries, and requires authentication.

title: test_user_settings_retrieval_and_update
description: Test the /api/user/settings endpoint to ensure authenticated users can retrieve their current settings and update preferences successfully, with proper validation and persistence.

title: test_health_check_endpoint
description: Verify the /api/health endpoint responds correctly without authentication, indicating the service status and readiness.
